core_principles: Sophisticated serif typography meets minimal geometric sans
Tactile depth over flat surfaces (grain, subtle glowing borders)
High contrast for legibility, low contrast for atmosphere

headings.styles: tracking-tight, elegant, used for hero and section headers. Sometimes use italics for sophisticated emphasis.

accents.styles: tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-xs for overlines and labels.

spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Generous (p-8, p-12, p-16, py-24). Allow the dark backgrounds to breathe.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Asymmetrical bento for marketing, strict 3/4 column control room for admin dashboard.

surfaces_and_components.cards: Dark surfaces (#141414) with subtle 1px border (border-white/10). No large drop shadows, rely on borders and inner glow.
surfaces_and_components.glassmorphism: Used for sticky header and modals. backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10.

buttons.primary: Solid gold (bg-[#d4af37] text-black hover:bg-[#b5952f] transition-all duration-300 rounded-sm)
buttons.secondary: Outline gold or outline white/20 with white text on hover.
buttons.ghost: Text only with gold underline on hover.

surfaces_and_components.inputs: Shadcn standard but styled dark: bg-[#0a0a0a] border-white/20 focus:border-[#d4af37] text-white.

motion.transitions: Slow, deliberate, elegant. transition-all duration-500 ease-out.
motion.hover_states: Images slightly scale up (scale-105) within hidden overflow containers. Buttons fade colors smoothly.
motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling with Lenis recommended. Reveal animations for sections.

hero_background.description: Abstract dark gold swirl, perfect for moody, ultra-premium landing hero overlay
hero_background.placement: Hero section background, optionally layered with black/60 gradient

tasting_kits.description: Close up red wine poured into glass, dark background

community_events.description: Rows of dark glass wine bottles stacked on shelves.
community_events.placement: Events calendar background or tasting journal visual

community_events.description: Rows of whiskey barrels in cellar

specific_pages.home: Dark moody hero with heavy abstract gold/black background (use bg-black/60 overlay to ensure text readability). Serif H1 text-5xl to text-7xl fluid. Featured tasting kits in asymmetrical bento grid.
specific_pages.events: Clean calendar layout using Shadcn, dark theme. Event cards with dark imagery, high contrast gold accent for dates.
specific_pages.foxhound_packs: Community groups page. Imagery of people tasting. Use slightly softer borders and avatar clusters.
specific_pages.profile_journal: Personal tasting journal. Use 'Control Room' grid but styled elegantly. Clean forms, high legibility.
specific_pages.admin: Purely functional. Use Archetype 4 (Swiss & High Contrast) applied to dark mode. Strict grid, dense data, pure utility.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT USE PLACEHOLDER IMAGES. Strictly use the URLs provided in the media section.
All interactive elements must have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Keep icon weight light to match serif luxury feel.
Install Google Fonts 'Playfair Display' and 'Manrope' in index.html or global css.
Header must use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0a0a0a]/80 border-b border-white/10) and sticky positioning z-50.
For the 'Coming Soon' features (Live Tasting Room, Bottle Scanner), create elegant disabled/locked state cards with a gold 'Coming Soon' badge.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the landing page marketing sections for asymmetrical layouts, avoid wrapping everything in Shadcn Cards.
